description: Embedded Capacity Register 50kW-1MW is a dataset listed in SP Energy Networks open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity network operator, published or maintained by SP Energy Networks. The " Embedded Capacity Register "(formerly the System Wide Resource Register) data table provides information on generation and storage resources (greater than or equal to 50kW, and less than 1MW) that are connected, or accepted to connect, to the SP Energy Network's distribution network. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal files it under Asset Data. Its keywords are Embedded Capacity Register, ECR, Generation, Connections, SPD, SPM. The portal shows 2026-08-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-spen-open-data-portal.
